title: Vertex lower bound for regular graphs of girth four
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph that is $k$-regular, meaning every vertex has exactly $k$ neighbors, and suppose $G$ has girth $4$, that is, the length of its shortest cycle is $4$. Then $G$ has at least $2k$ vertices.
replaced:
\emph{A \texttt{k}-regular graph of girth four has at least \texttt{2k}
vertices.}
